recent_posts: The Guyana dollar sits at 209.2 per US dollar, barely moved from 209.3 at the start of the year. It has held inside a 2.6% band for twelve months, changing on two of every three trading days. #Guyana $GYD
The Liberian dollar sits at 181.6 per US dollar, five straight days without a move of even a quarter percent. Still, it's 10.4% firmer than a year ago, when it traded near 200.4. #Liberia $LRD

The sol trades at 3.373 per dollar. The 5 sources feeding the fixing disagree among themselves by 0.66%, more than double the usual 0.26% discrepancy for this currency, though the rate remains within the 1.1% band it has held over 30 days. #Peru $PEN

The Moroccan dirham stands at 9.292 to the dollar, little changed over the past week. Since the start of the year the currency has fallen 1.9%, and over the past year the decline reached 3.1%. #Morocco $MAD
